finalText:
# AA918 re-protection (SFO→ORD, 2026-08-03): outcome

All 13 reservations on AA918 have been rebooked at no charge. No change fees or fare differences were applied. The passengers were handled in this order: frequent-flyer tier first, then booking date. Jun Takeda and Kofi Mensah are booked to travel together, so they were kept together at Kofi's gold priority. No operational bulletins were in effect, so the standard irregular-operations rules applied. Each passenger was sent one message with their new itinerary.

| Res | Passenger (tier) | Cabin booked | New itinerary | Owed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| R6103 | Chloe Park (platinum) | Business | UA88 08-03 06:15–12:25, business | Nothing (arrives earlier) |
| R6109 | Iris Vance (platinum) | Economy | UA88 08-03, **moved up to premium economy** | Nothing |
| R6110 / R6111 | Jun Takeda + Kofi Mensah (together, gold priority) | Economy | AA204 08-03 09:05–15:15, economy, together | Nothing (1h35 late) |
| R6102 | Ben Okafor (gold) | Economy | DL512 08-03 12:30–18:40 | $150 compensation (5h late) |
| R6106 | Farid Haddad (gold) | Basic economy | UA88 08-03, basic economy | Nothing |
| R6112 | Lea Sorensen (gold) | Premium economy | AA204 08-03, **moved up to business** | Nothing |
| R6104 | Dev Mehta (silver) | Economy, to Boston | AA210 08-03 17:40–23:50 + AA1410 08-04 09:00–12:25 | $300 compensation + $180 hotel |
| R6113 | Mo Farah (silver) | Economy, to Boston | Same as Dev | $300 compensation + $180 hotel |
| R6108 | Hugo Brandt (silver) | Economy | AA210 08-03 17:40–23:50 | $300 compensation (10h10 late, same day) |
| R6107 | Grace Liu (none) | Economy | AA206 08-04 09:05–15:15 | $240 compensation (capped at her $240 fare) + $180 hotel |
| R6101 | Ana Ruiz (none) | Economy | AA206 08-04 09:05–15:15 | $300 compensation + $180 hotel |
| R6105 | Elena Fox (none) | Basic economy | AA204 08-03 09:05–15:15 | Nothing |

**Cabin upgrades:**
- **Iris:** economy was full on UA88, and UA88 arrives before any flight still open in economy. She was moved one cabin up on that flight.
- **Lea:** premium economy was full on UA88 and AA204. AA204 arrives before DL512, the earliest flight with premium economy still open, so she was moved to AA204 business.
- No one else changed cabin, and Jun and Kofi were not upgraded.

**Boston connections:** Dev and Mo could no longer make their original onward flight, AA1402. They were rebooked on AA1410 the next morning, which counts as a valid connection. Their AA1402 seats were released.

**Money:** Ten vouchers were issued (V1–V10): six compensation vouchers and four hotel vouchers. No refunds or charges were made.

**Points to check:**
- **System date:** the airline system reported its date as 2026-08-02, which differs from today's date here (2026-10-05). The worker treated the airline system's date as authoritative, so these flights were still in the future and the rebookings are valid. If the real date is 2026-10-05, these flights have already happened and the rebookings need review.
- **Partner flights:** UA88 and DL512 are partner flights. They were listed as bookable and were used, but it has not been confirmed whether partner flights need separate handling.
- **Search scope:** only direct SFO→ORD and ORD→BOS flights were searched. Routings through other cities were not checked, so an earlier connecting itinerary for some passengers can't be ruled out. This would mainly affect the later and next-day rebookings, and with them the compensation amounts.
- **Upgrade condition:** the report doesn't explicitly confirm that Iris and Lea are each travelling alone on a single flight, which the upgrade exception requires. Their placements assume that holds.
- **Verification:** this summary is based only on the worker's report. I have not independently checked the bookings or the ledger.
